clauses.scope_note: Restriction on use of Mistral AI Products or Outputs; includes applicable law (including sanctions and export control laws), these Terms, the Usage Policy, and other Mistral AI policies.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when the use violates any listed law, term, or policy. Other policies may be updated from time to time.

obligation_items.content: Do not use Mistral AI Products or Outputs in a manner that violates applicable law, these Terms, the Usage Policy, or another Mistral AI policy.
obligation_items.actor: Customer and persons Customer permits, including End Users
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever the proposed use would violate applicable law, these Terms, the Usage Policy, or another Mistral AI policy.

clauses.scope_note: Restriction on use of Mistral AI Products that infringes, misappropriates, or otherwise violates third-party rights, including intellectual property or privacy rights; example includes intentionally generating Outputs similar to or in the style of protected content.
clauses.condition_explanation: The example is illustrative; the operative restriction covers any use that infringes, misappropriates, or otherwise violates a third party’s rights.

obligation_items.content: Do not use Mistral AI Products in a manner that infringes, misappropriates, or otherwise violates third-party rights, including intellectual property or privacy rights.
obligation_items.actor: Customer and persons Customer permits, including End Users
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever the use would infringe, misappropriate, or otherwise violate a third party’s rights.

clauses.scope_note: Prohibits including specified children’s personal information as Customer Data and allowing minors to use Products without legally adequate parental or guardian consent.
clauses.condition_explanation: The applicable age is under 13 or the applicable age of digital consent. Either specified circumstance triggers the restriction.

obligation_items.content: Do not include personal information of children under 13 or the applicable age of digital consent as Customer Data.
obligation_items.actor: Customer and persons Customer permits, including End Users
obligation_items.trigger: When the personal information is that of a child under 13 or the applicable age of digital consent.

obligation_items.content: Do not allow minors to use Mistral AI Products without legally adequate consent from their parent or guardian.
obligation_items.actor: Customer and persons Customer permits, including End Users
obligation_items.object: Minor use of Mistral AI Products
obligation_items.trigger: When a minor would use the Products without legally adequate parental or guardian consent.

clauses.scope_note: Separately stated restriction against using Output or any modified version of Output to reverse engineer Mistral AI Products.
clauses.condition_explanation: Applies to use of either Output or modified Output for the stated reverse-engineering purpose.

obligation_items.content: Do not use Output or a modified version of Output to reverse engineer Mistral AI Products.
obligation_items.actor: Customer and persons Customer permits, including End Users
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever Output or modified Output is used to reverse engineer Mistral AI Products.

clauses.scope_note: Restriction covers compromising or attempting to compromise Product security or proper functionality, including interference with, circumvention of, or bypassing security or moderation mechanisms and vulnerability, penetration, or similar testing.
clauses.condition_explanation: The listed actions are examples included in the prohibition, not an exhaustive list.

obligation_items.content: Do not compromise or attempt to compromise the security or proper functionality of Mistral AI Products, including by interfering with, circumventing, or bypassing security or moderation mechanisms or performing vulnerability, penetration, or similar testing.
obligation_items.actor: Customer and persons Customer permits, including End Users
obligation_items.object: Security and proper functionality of Mistral AI Products
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever the conduct compromises or attempts to compromise Product security or proper functionality.

clauses.scope_note: Restriction concerns buying, selling, or transferring API keys or any type of Mistral AI account from, to, or with a third party.
clauses.condition_explanation: Any of the stated transactions involving a third party is prohibited.

obligation_items.content: Do not buy, sell, or transfer API keys or any type of Mistral AI account from, to, or with a third party.
obligation_items.actor: Customer and persons Customer permits, including End Users
obligation_items.object: Mistral AI API keys or accounts
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever a purchase, sale, or transfer from, to, or with a third party is proposed or undertaken.

clauses.scope_note: Beta Products may be made available for Customer’s internal evaluation and testing only; Customer may not distribute them or otherwise provide third-party access.
clauses.condition_explanation: The restriction applies to either distribution of a Beta Product or otherwise providing access to it to any third party.

obligation_items.content: Do not distribute Beta Products or otherwise provide access to Beta Products to any third party.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever Customer proposes to distribute a Beta Product or provide third-party access to one.
